access_note: The public EIDA federator covers open network holdings only. Some station networks are restricted and require their node-specific access route. Data must be cited by network, and excessive automated use can be suspended. No waveform was requested or downloaded.
description: ORFEUS operates the European Integrated Data Archive as a federation of seismic data centres. The public service provides waveform records from participating seismic networks and station metadata through standardized FDSN data-selection, station and availability web services. Its federator routes requests across open node holdings; restricted networks are excluded from that route. Earthquake and ground-motion modellers can use the waveforms to test source or propagation models, then pass hazard fields to infrastructure exposure and resilience simulations. The archive also provides waveform quality metadata and network-specific citations. Its data policy says access is free, asks users to cite suppliers and prohibits unaltered commercial reuse; this is a provider policy, not an open licence. Coverage varies by network, instrument and time, and a station record does not by itself establish site-specific ground motion at an infrastructure asset. The 2024 Data Science Journal article describes data-delivery metrics for the distributed archive, but those metrics are separate from the waveform observations. No waveform, station inventory or quality stream was downloaded or numerically checked. The current service pages, not the article publication year, determine this record’s access description. Related catalogue records for individual national seismic networks have narrower geographic scope.
